short_prompt: Ilustra un dique seco con una estación de bombeo, cinco trabajadores y anotaciones en inglés.
intent: A conceptual dry dock with one supported ship, two pumps, five workers and a common discharge header.

relationships: existing typed interfaces or localized attachments

negative_controls: Incorrect inventory; floating worker, displaced route endpoint, detached attachment or shaft/bearing misalignment where the actual fixture defines them.
limits: No final-pixel observation is supplied by these geometry commands.
Coverage partial remains partial; a schema number or successful loader cannot promote it to complete strict coverage.
No load, dynamics, hydraulic or biomechanical certification.
